subject.title: [Bug]: Clarify Telegram channel_post auth when groups[chatId].allowFrom is configured

question: For Telegram channel_post native/plugin commands, should configured groups[chatId].allowFrom be ignored in favor of explicit chat allow, or should sender-scoped allowFrom make channel_post commands unsupported/fail-closed with clear docs and messaging?
rationale: Telegram channel_post lacks the normal human sender identity used by current sender-scoped allowFrom checks, and either policy changes the authorization boundary for operators trying to restrict a channel by sender.

options.title: Fail Closed For Sender-Scoped Overrides
options.body: Reject channel_post commands when sender-scoped per-chat allowFrom is configured, and document that Telegram does not provide the required human sender identity.

options.title: Use Explicit Chat Allow Only
options.body: Permit channel_post commands from explicitly configured channel chats and document that per-chat sender-scoped allowFrom is ignored on this surface.

options.title: Defer To Broader Bot-To-Bot Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open until broader Telegram bot-to-bot policy work defines channel, peer-bot, and sender identity together.

recommendation.title: Fail Closed For Sender-Scoped Overrides
recommendation.body: Reject channel_post commands when sender-scoped per-chat allowFrom is configured, and document that Telegram does not provide the required human sender identity.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history in the Telegram native command and callback paths that this policy would affect.
